d:
Navratri ke baad ghar par banayein bazaar jaisa Gujarati Fafda Papad khar wali asli trick ke saath!
Besan mein lochh kaise laayein ki Fafda na toote. Poonam Devnani ke saath Fafda + khatti-meethi-teekhi hari mirch + Papaya Sambharo, sab ek hi video mein.
barik besan se kurkura gujrati phaphra
papar khar se besan men loch, phaphra na tute
khatti-mithi-tikhi hari mirch
kachche papite ka sanbharo
Comment karein: Aapko Fafda kiske saath pasand hai, hari chutney ya Papaya Sambharo ke saath? Aur kya Poonam ko Fafda ki dukaan khol leni chahiye?
